subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Require a complete typed active-surface inventory with zero unexplained residual feature entry points before authority publication.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: An exact selector can still be incomplete. FR-14, UB-9, DOD-6, and DOD-7 make omitted sources, units, entry points, and shared dispositions visible before cleanup.
fit_criterion: The pilot and fixture inventories report zero unexplained residual surface; every omitted exclusive identity, unresolved entry point, unowned live reference, and undispositioned shared identity refuses.
